lines.zh: 白毛兽轻跃前行，发出低沉叫声。
lines.en: White Grizzle jumps quietly, growling softly.

lines.zh: 它用毛茸茸的爪子在地面上滑行。
lines.en: Its fluffy paws slide across the ground.

lines.zh: 白毛兽低头觅食，寻找食物。
lines.en: White Grizzle lowers its head to search for food.

lines.zh: 它在雪地里欢快地奔跑。
lines.en: It runs happily in the snow.
White Grizzle quickly traverses the snow.
It saunters leisurely in the forest.

lines.zh: 白毛兽轻巧地跳跃，追逐着食物。
lines.en: White Grizzle leaps lightly, chasing food.
White Grizzle walks slowly in the snow.
It moves through the trees.

lines.zh: 白毛兽在雪地里轻快地移动。
lines.en: White Grizzle moves gracefully in the snow.
White Grizzle walks off over the snow crust.
It noses the snow aside.
It paces slowly along the riverbank.
Its thick paws sink into soft snow.

lines.zh: 白毛兽静静地站立，似乎在沉思。
lines.en: White Grizzle stands quietly, seeming to think.
It looks around for food.

lines.zh: 白毛兽坐在雪地上，享受着温暖。
lines.en: White Grizzle sits on the snow, enjoying the warmth.

lines.zh: 它用爪子梳理着柔软的毛皮。
lines.en: It scratches its soft fur with its claws.

lines.zh: 白毛兽静静地站立，聆听周围的声音。
lines.en: White Grizzle stands quietly, listening to its surroundings.
It lazily lies on the snow.

lines.zh: 白毛兽静静地坐着，思考问题。
lines.en: White Grizzle sits quietly, pondering.

lines.zh: 它在雪地里悠闲地打滚。
lines.en: It rolls playfully in the snow.

lines.zh: 白毛兽静静地坐着，享受宁静。
lines.en: White Grizzle sits quietly, enjoying the peace.

lines.zh: 它静静地坐在树旁，看着远方。
lines.en: It sits quietly by the tree, looking into the distance.
It rests its chin on a stone.
It shakes the snow off its back.
It stares blankly at the treeline.
It wets its nose with its tongue.

lines.zh: 白毛兽转向你，发出好奇的声音。
lines.en: White Grizzle turns to you, making a curious sound.

lines.zh: 白熊这么温顺，你还怕什么。
lines.en: A white bear this gentle — what's there to fear?

lines.zh: 白毛兽靠近你，嗅探你的气味。
lines.en: White Grizzle approaches you, sniffing your scent.
It watches you vigilantly.
White Grizzle looks at you curiously.

lines.zh: 它用毛茸茸的脸靠近你。
lines.en: Its fluffy face approaches you.

lines.zh: 白毛兽靠近你，想亲近你。
lines.en: White Grizzle approaches you, wanting to be close.
It looks at you nervously.
White Grizzle stares at you警惕地.

lines.zh: 它好奇地看你手中的东西。
lines.en: It looks curiously at what you're holding.
It smells the dried fish on you.
Its nose comes close to your hand.
It tilts its head at the egg in your hand.
It backs off half a step, then stops.
It is sizing up your height.
It touches you with a paw tip.
It grunts to show it heard you.
It blocks the cub behind it.
It stares at your belt.
Its ears swivel toward you.

lines.zh: 白毛兽受了伤，呜呜叫唤起来。
lines.en: The White Grizzle cries in pain.

lines.zh: 我的白毛兽同伴受伤了。
lines.en: The White Grizzle is injured.

lines.zh: 我的白毛兽受了伤，需要治疗。
lines.en: The White Grizzle needs healing.
Be careful, the White Grizzle is injured.

lines.zh: 白毛兽的皮毛受伤了，好疼。
lines.en: The White Grizzle’s fur is hurt.

lines.zh: 白毛兽受伤了，小心别再伤它。
lines.en: Be careful, the White Grizzle is injured.
The White Grizzle has wounds.
Poor injured White Grizzle.

lines.zh: 白毛兽受了伤，叫声凄厉。
lines.en: The White Grizzle cries out in pain.

lines.zh: 我的白毛兽受了伤，需要关心。
lines.en: The White Grizzle needs care.
Here, have some fish.
Want some carrots?
Try my cookies.
Here’s a candy, sweetheart.
Stay, give me something to eat.
Come here, I have honey.
Come, I have apples.
Try my mushrooms.

lines.zh: 你看起来饿了，吃点面包吧。
lines.en: You look hungry, eat some bread.
Come, have some sweets, sweetheart.
Ouch, don’t bump into me.
Don’t run, you might bump into me.
Be careful, don’t knock me down.
Slow down, don’t bump into me.
Don’t rush, I’ll walk slower.
Don’t come too close, I’m steady.

lines.zh: 小心点，别撞到我的小窝。
lines.en: Be careful, don’t bump into my nest.
Don’t touch me, I’m resting.
Stay away, I’m dangerous.

lines.zh: 白熊的爪子搭上你的肩。
lines.en: The white bear's paw lands on your shoulder.
Follow me, we need a mate.
Find a mate, hurry up.
Go out and find a partner.
Let’s find a mate.
Find a mate, quickly.

lines.zh: 我们一起出去找另一半。
lines.en: Let’s go out and find a partner.
We need a mate.
Don’t go, come with me.
Follow me, I’ll lead the way.
It follows a scent across the snow.

lines.zh: 白毛兽低吼一声，你递上食物它便收下了。
lines.en: White Grizzle growls lowly, accepting your offering.

lines.zh: 你扔了块肉，白毛兽张开大嘴咬住了。
lines.en: You throw a piece of meat; White Grizzle bites it open.

lines.zh: 白毛兽低头吃草，仿佛在享受自然。
lines.en: White Grizzle grazes on the grass, savoring the nature.

lines.zh: 你喂它胡萝卜，白毛兽满意地咀嚼。
lines.en: You give it a carrot; White Grizzle chews contentedly.

lines.zh: 白毛兽低头舔舐地面的水洼。
lines.en: White Grizzle licks a puddle on the ground.

lines.zh: 你递上蜂蜜，白毛兽张嘴接住。
lines.en: You offer honey; White Grizzle catches it.

lines.zh: 白毛兽啃食着树皮，看起来很开心。
lines.en: White Grizzle munches on bark, looking pleased.

lines.zh: 你喂它蘑菇，白毛兽点头表示感谢。
lines.en: You give it a mushroom; White Grizzle nods in thanks.

lines.zh: 白毛兽伸长舌头舔你的手。
lines.en: White Grizzle licks your hand with its long tongue.

lines.zh: 你喂它树叶，白毛兽点头致谢。
lines.en: You give it leaves; White Grizzle nods in thanks.

lines.zh: 你靠近时，白毛兽警惕地盯着你。
lines.en: White Grizzle watches you warily as you approach.

lines.zh: 你试图抚摸它，白毛兽警惕起来。
lines.en: White Grizzle becomes alert when you try to pet it.

lines.zh: 你突然靠近，白毛兽做出攻击准备。
lines.en: White Grizzle prepares to attack as you suddenly approach.

lines.zh: 你试图抓住它，白毛兽迅速躲开。
lines.en: White Grizzle swiftly avoids you as you try to catch it.

lines.zh: 你试图喂它，白毛兽保持警惕。
lines.en: White Grizzle stays alert as you try to feed it.

lines.zh: 你靠近时，白毛兽的耳朵竖了起来。
lines.en: White Grizzle pricks its ears as you approach.

lines.zh: 你试图接近它，白毛兽保持距离。
lines.en: White Grizzle keeps its distance as you try to approach.

lines.zh: 你走近时，白毛兽保持警惕。
lines.en: White Grizzle remains alert as you approach.

lines.zh: 你试图与它互动，白毛兽显得不安。
lines.en: White Grizzle seems uneasy as you try to interact.

lines.zh: 你靠近时，白毛兽盯着你看。
lines.en: White Grizzle stares at you as you approach.

lines.zh: 你瞄准白毛兽，它警惕地观察你。
lines.en: You aim at White Grizzle; it watches you warily.

lines.zh: 你瞄准白毛兽，它低吼以示警告。
lines.en: You aim at White Grizzle; it growls in warning.

lines.zh: 你瞄准白毛兽，它迅速躲开。
lines.en: You aim at White Grizzle; it dodges quickly.

lines.zh: 你瞄准白毛兽，它保持警惕。
lines.en: You aim at White Grizzle; it stays alert.

lines.zh: 你瞄准白毛兽，它似乎意识到危险。
lines.en: You aim at White Grizzle; it realizes the danger.

lines.zh: 你瞄准白毛兽，它警觉地低吼。
lines.en: You aim at White Grizzle; it growls alertly.

lines.zh: 你瞄准白毛兽，它试图逃开。
lines.en: You aim at White Grizzle; it tries to escape.

lines.zh: 你瞄准白毛兽，它躲开你的视线。
lines.en: You aim at White Grizzle; it dodges your gaze.
It lowers itself over its companion.
It lifts a forepaw, claws showing.

lines.zh: 怒吼一声，利爪划破空气。
lines.en: Roar, claws slice the air.
Roar and charge at the enemy.
Paw swings, ground trembles.
Wide eyes, charge forward.
Giant palm strikes, howling wind.
Palm slaps, enemy falls.
Bear paw swings, enemy retreats.

lines.zh: 咆哮震耳欲聋，扑向猎物。
lines.en: Roar deafening, charge prey.

lines.zh: 利爪撕裂，敌人血肉模糊。
lines.en: Claws rip, enemy bloody.
Pounce, giant palm suppresses.
In the forest, white bears appear.
In cold mountains, white bears dwell.
Hunter beware, white bears appear.
In snow, white bear tracks.
In forest clearings, white bears appear.
In cold winds, white bear roars.
Frozen valley, white bear home.
Winter forest, white bears active.
In deep snow, white bear tracks.
In snow, white bears occasionally appear.
The White Grizzle is burned.
The White Grizzle fell from a height.

lines.zh: 白毛兽掉入水中淹死了。
lines.en: The White Grizzle drowned.
The White Grizzle was injured by explosion.
The White Grizzle was hit by an arrow.

lines.zh: 白毛兽被魔法击中受伤。
lines.en: The White Grizzle was injured by magic.

lines.zh: 白毛兽饿伤了，快给它食物。
lines.en: The White Grizzle is starved.
The White Grizzle was hit by lightning.

lines.zh: 白毛兽掉入末地消失了。
lines.en: The White Grizzle fell into the Nether.
